recent_posts.title: Reuna Presenter - Multi-screen projection software for churches, in the browser
recent_posts.summary: Reuna Presenter is a browser-based church presentation app built as a web alternative to ProPresenter and EasyWorship. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, Supabase, and TypeScript in a Turborepo monorepo, it supports multi-screen projection with independent content per display, a stage monitor view for performers, drag-and-drop service planning, a cloud-shared song library, Bible search with offline support, mobile remote control via QR code, container-query-based templates, MIDI cue triggering, and an interactive 2D canvas for managing physical screen layouts. The solo developer is offering 10 days of PRO access to church tech teams willing to test it in a live Sunday service.

recent_posts.title: I built a headless React hook for multi-step forms with conditional branching, Zod validation, and persistence
recent_posts.summary: FormTrek is a headless React hook library for building multi-step forms with conditional branching, per-step Zod validation, and pluggable persistence (localStorage, sessionStorage, URL params, or custom). The API centers on a single `useTrek` hook that accepts steps as plain objects, supports TypeScript, and has zero UI dependencies so developers retain full rendering control. It can be installed via `pnpm dlx formtrek init` or manually with `pnpm add formtrek zod`.

recent_posts.title: ServerCN, Backend Component Registry
recent_posts.summary: ServerCN is an open-source component registry for Node.js backends that simplifies adding common features like OAuth (GitHub, Google), file uploads (Cloudinary, ImageKit), and email services to TypeScript projects through CLI commands. Inspired by shadcn/ui, it allows developers to add pre-built backend components directly into their codebase with a single command. The project is currently under development with commands not yet functional.

recent_posts.title: I made a tool to understand why stocks move the way they do
recent_posts.summary: Stock Pulse is an AI-powered stock analysis platform that analyzes 10-Q filings, earnings reports, and financial data to surface insights and trends. The application is built with Next.js App Router, Firebase for authentication and database, React Query for data fetching, Zustand for state management, Recharts for visualization, and OpenAI API for AI-driven analysis. The platform is hosted on Vercel and available for free use.

recent_posts.title: Tired of setting up Vite + React + Tailwind again and again?
recent_posts.summary: A CLI tool called create-vrtw automates the setup of React projects with Vite, offering built-in support for Tailwind v4 or Bootstrap 5. It can install additional packages like React Router or Redux and removes default boilerplate code. The tool works with npm, bun, pnpm, and yarn package managers.

recent_posts.title: Why be late, when Nityasha is here?
recent_posts.summary: Nityasha is an AI-powered personal assistant that integrates with Notion to streamline workflows through automated note management, task organization, research assistance, and image search capabilities.

recent_posts.title: Static is boring — animate your icons 🎯
recent_posts.summary: AnimateIcons is a React library that transforms static SVG icons into smooth animations. It offers 45+ animated icons, works with React and Next.js, supports hover and programmatic control, and integrates with ShadCN CLI. The library aims to enhance user interfaces by adding purposeful motion to icons.

recent_posts.title: Building My Own Enigma Machine Simulator
recent_posts.summary: A developer built a full-stack Enigma machine simulator using React, TypeScript, and Express.js with MongoDB. The project recreates the historic WWII encryption device with features like symmetric encryption/decryption, custom machine generation via seed and email, and an interactive UI with rotor and plugboard simulation. The implementation includes both frontend visualization and backend API handling, demonstrating cryptographic principles while serving as an educational tool.

recent_posts.title: Your API’s Cute, But Can It Survive the Streets? 🤷‍♂️
recent_posts.summary: A guide to backend security fundamentals including JWT authentication, input validation, and secrets management, explained through restaurant metaphors to make security concepts more accessible and memorable for developers.

recent_posts.title: AI-powered UI/UX and Frontend assistant
recent_posts.summary: Webless.dev is an AI-powered design tool that combines visual interface design with automated code generation. It features a Figma-like canvas editor, AI-driven design generation, and exports to semantic HTML/CSS/JavaScript. The platform includes automated design systems, style guides, and plans to add real-time collaboration, Git integration, and database connectivity for complete web development workflows.
